Privacy Policy

Effective 10 October 2026. Michael Schlunegger, publishing as Navarro Studios.

LeftPhoneAlert uses information from your iPhone and Apple Watch to provide protection status, alerts and Safe Zones.

Information used on your devices

The app uses device-connection information, location and motion/activity information for its features. App storage holds settings, saved Safe Zones and their names, protection preferences and diagnostic records. Relevant pairing credentials use secure system storage.

Configuration and Safe Zone information is synchronized between your paired iPhone and Apple Watch. On-device processing is distinct from information sent to the developer.

Permissions you control

Location supports mapping and Safe Zone detection. Motion/activity supports movement-aware features. Notification permission enables alerts and reminders. The operating system controls these permissions; changing them can affect app behavior.

Maps and other Apple services

The app uses Apple Maps and place search. Map and search requests may be processed by Apple under its privacy terms and your system settings. Apple also handles App Store purchases and distribution.

The application source reviewed for this release contains no advertising or analytics SDK and no developer-operated automatic telemetry upload.

Apple’s privacy information

Diagnostics you choose to share

Diagnostic reports leave the app through export or sharing actions you initiate. Depending on the report type, they may contain event times, device and connection information, settings, and precise location. Detailed event CSV files can include latitude and longitude.

Review reports before sharing. Files you send to another recipient are subject to that recipient’s handling practices.

Contacting support

When you email leftphonealert.support@gmail.com, your email address, message and any attachments are received through Gmail. Do not send passwords or pairing codes. Send only the diagnostic information needed to understand your request.

We use support messages only to answer your requests and investigate app issues. We retain them only as long as needed for those purposes or to meet legal obligations. You can request deletion by emailing leftphonealert.support@gmail.com.

Managing and removing data

Use the available app and device controls to manage saved information and permissions. Changes such as deleting a Safe Zone can synchronize when your devices connect.

Deleting the app does not necessarily remove exported files, information on your other device, or credentials retained in secure system storage. Contact support for help with removing data. We cannot remove copies you have shared with other recipients.

Privacy questions

Contact leftphonealert.support@gmail.com about privacy or deletion requests.
